properties.instruction:

the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

physical stress. If smoke impacts your area; 1) Have a cooling plan
in place as smoke could limit your ability to cool your home through
open windows and 2) If you have air conditioning, set on air
recirculation within the home to avoid smoke exposure. Local
officials may have additional guidance.

properties.description:
SMWAKQ

The National Weather Service in Wakefield has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Chesapeake Bay from Little Creek VA to Cape Henry VA including the
Chesapeake Bay Bridge Tunnel...
Chesapeake Bay from New Point Comfort to Little Creek VA...
Chesapeake Bay from Smith Point to Windmill Point VA...
Chesapeake Bay from Windmill Point to New Point Comfort VA...
Rappahannock River from Urbanna to Windmill Point...

* Until 1145 PM EDT.

* At 1018 PM EDT, a front was located along a line extending from
near Nandua Pungoteague Reef to near Windmill Point to 7 nm west of
Urbanna Inlet, moving southeast at 20 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Marine observations.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
New Point Comfort, Nassawadox Reef, Wolf Trap, Thimble Shoals,
Urbanna Inlet, Tue Marshes Light, Stingray Point, Onancock Inlet,
Occohannock Reef, The Hump, The Cell, Cape Charles Light, Cabbage
Patch, Longs Creek Inlet, Cape Charles Harbor, Windmill Point,
Rappahannock Range Light, Rappahannock Light, Latimer Shoal, and
Plantation Light.
